title: political uncertainty and stock market volatility: a comparative analysis of presidential elections in sub-asean markets
core_idea: Investigate how presidential elections affect stock return volatility in four sub-South East Asian markets (Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Philippines) using a GARCH model with pre- and post-election dummy variables to provide a comparative analysis across countries with similar political and economic conditions.
tldr: Uses a GARCH model with election dummies to compare the impact of presidential elections on stock return volatility across four sub-Southeast Asian markets.
